stem: An orchard has \((2x + 5)\) rows of trees with \((x + 9)\) trees in each row. A storm destroys \(7x\) of the trees. The number of trees remaining can be written as \(ax^{2} + bx + c\), where \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\) are constants. What is the value of \(b\)?
verify:
x = symbols('x')
p = Poly(expand((2*x + 5)*(x + 9) - 7*x), x)
assert p.coeff_monomial(x) == 16
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == [16]
